prompts: Create a production game sprite source atlas using ONLY B1 the bell-shaped spinning foundry machine in the LEFT column of reference. Not a concept presentation. TRANSPARENT background, no text labels, no grid lines, no shadows on ground, no effects outside body. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows evenly spaced equal cells, 8 full-body isolated sprites with generous transparent margins. Top row NORMAL CLOSED: front, right, back, left. Bottom row ENRAGED OPEN same corresponding directions: front, right, back, left. Orthographic top-down RPG camera 35 degrees downward, show top surfaces, identical camera light from upper left and identical body scale all cells. Rich handcrafted textured game art, dark outlined readable forms, worn cast iron, chipped warm cream ceramic panels, antique brass rivets, soot and burned metal. Substantial thick casting mold armor and low heavy rotating base, short central spindle, front narrow orange inspection slit and one short industrial molten-metal pouring spout on right side, circular rivet launcher ports around bottom ring. No robot limbs, no face, no humanoid, no vacuum cleaner. Bottom row opens the SAME four hinged heavy shell panels outward revealing ribbed crucible and orange hot inner furnace. Keep base diameter and central machinery unchanged, opening panels increase silhouette only. Inner hot orange contained to surface, no smoke/fire/glow halo baked outside. Back has hinges and exhaust valves, not duplicate front. Side silhouettes accurately preserve asymmetric pouring spout. Every sprite fully contained inside its cell, ground base centered at same cell coordinate, no perspective platform, no scenery. Sheet is high resolution ready for subsequent extraction and rig preparation, visually sumptuous but readable at 180px width.

Production game asset PARTS atlas for ONLY bell-shaped spinning foundry boss from provided full-body reference. 4 columns x 3 rows exactly, twelve isolated objects with generous equal margins, TRANSPARENT alpha background (no dark gradient, no paper, no checkerboard painted into image), NO labels text borders scenery or ground shadows. Same orthographic 35 degree overhead view, light upper left, detailed painterly game art worn cast iron chipped cream enamel bronze soot. Row1: complete low rotating circular gun-port BASE ONLY with EMPTY OPEN central socket; ribbed crucible CORE ONLY with spindle and orange internal surface glow; CLOSED bell-shaped upper SHELL ONLY with inspection slit no base; short molten metal pouring SPOUT ONLY. Row2 four separate hinged curved armor petals in outward-open orientations: front-left, front-right, rear-left, rear-right. Each petal has complete thickness dark iron underside rivets and hinge attachment, no cropped edges, no duplication of underlying core. Row3: detached solid central spindle CAP ONLY; detached rivet launcher BARREL ONLY pointing right; broken cream armor shard group 3 separated chunks; collapsed burnt-out boss wreck with open shell dark extinguished core. No human limbs, no humanoid faces. Reference used for exact material vocabulary and boss identity. Separate functional components for subsequent animation rigging; no smoke sparks or external glow halos baked into solids. Strong clean silhouettes, premium tactile material detail, no flat vector approximation.

Create a premium 2D game VFX source atlas for an old iron foundry spinning boss in a top-down dungeon. TRANSPARENT alpha background, NO checkerboard pattern NO opaque backdrop NO text NO labels NO grid NO boss body NO scenery. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of equal cells and generous empty gutters, 16 separate isolated sprites. Each row a coherent FOUR FRAME animation from left to right, fixed common center and scale within each row; don't resize every frame to fill cell. Painterly crisp richly textured warm orange gold sparks, subtle charcoal ash, white-hot short cores, energetic but readable at small game size. Row 1: expanding horizontal elliptical ground shockwave ring (top-down oblique floor perspective) from small bright narrow complete ring to medium to large then fading broken large rim; transparent empty interior, sparse gravel and dust confined to circumference, not a solid explosion disk. Row 2: muzzle flash facing RIGHT, ignition tiny spark, short bright cone flare, branching hot sparks with few glowing metal flecks, dissipating smoke; muzzle origin fixed at 30 percent across cell and vertical center. Row 3: scraping spark wake from dash travelling RIGHT, low trailing hot sparks swept LEFT along ground, first contact to dense fan to longer fading streaks to sparse ember trails, contact origin fixed at 70 percent across cell. Row 4: heavy landing impact burst of ground dust and small stone fragments, starts small at ground center, expands into low elliptical dusty crown, wider thinning wisps, almost dissipated dust. Keep effect silhouettes separate, all fully inside cells. Semi-transparent edges and genuine empty alpha. No gigantic bloom, no lens flares, no blue magic, no symbols. Effects should feel like heavy iron grinding stone and compressed hot air. This atlas will be sliced later; do not combine different effect types in the same cell.
